title: PattyBuildDE
description: PattyBuild is a CityBuild-Network that also have KnockIT and SMP.
body:
PattyBuild.de – Your German Minecraft server network

Welcome to PattyBuild.de, a German Minecraft server network for all players who enjoy building, farming, trading and surviving at a leisurely pace, and who want to experience Minecraft together with others. Our server is aimed both at new players simply looking for a pleasant introduction to the game, and at experienced Minecraft players seeking a long-term network with a variety of game areas.

At the heart of PattyBuild is our CityBuild mode. Here, you can secure your own plots of land, gather resources and bring your ideas to life freely. Whether it’s a small starter house, a large villa, a modern shop, a warehouse, a farm area or a creative building project – you decide for yourself what to do with your plot. The economy system also gives you the chance to trade with other players, sell items and gradually build up your own fortune.

We also have an SMP area where the focus is on the classic survival experience. There, you can explore the world with other players, gather resources, build bases, go on adventures and play Minecraft in a more natural way. SMP mode is particularly suited to players who enjoy roaming freely and want to build a world together with others.

Our KnockbackFFA / Nocket mode offers a bit more variety. There, you can compete against other players in short PvP rounds, improve your movement skills and simply enjoy some action now and then without having to dive straight into a large-scale PvP system. PattyBuild.de aims to be a well-organised, stable and friendly network. It’s important to us that new players settle in quickly, that fair rules apply, and that everyone has the chance to play in peace. Whether you want to build, farm, trade, survive or simply become part of a community – you’ll find your place at PattyBuild.

If you fancy a German Minecraft network featuring CityBuild, SMP, KnockbackFFA, a relaxed community and plenty of ways to play, then do pop by. Server IP: pattybuild.de

Server by PattyXDHD, created with heart and love
